{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Colton}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:Colton.png]] |name=Jeremoch Colton |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Film|III}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]],[[Jedi Knights 3|''Jedi Knights'' 3]] later gray[[Crimson Reign 3|''Crimson Reign'' 3]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Reborn|cardname=ROTS-18 - Captain Colton|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/135181/cid/10118793/2017-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files:-Reborn-ROTS-18-Captain-Colton}} |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[House of Organa]] *[[Galactic Republic]] *[[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] **[[Rebel Alliance Navy]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|We are receiving a message from the Chancellor's office, sir.''"
"''Send it through.''"
"''Yes, sir.|Jeremoch Colton and Bail Organa|audio=Colton-Organa.flac|}} [[Captain]] '''Jeremoch Colton''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as [[pilot]] of the [[Alderaanian]] [[starship]]s ''[[Tantive III]]'' and ''[[Tantive IV]]'', [[corvette]]s used by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of the [[House of Organa]]. He was an extraordinary pilot and served as somewhat of a [[Teacher|mentor]] to Captain [[Raymus Antilles]], the [[Commanding officer|commander]] of the two vessels. Between [[40 BBY]] and [[34 BBY]], Colton captained a [[CR70 corvette]] with Organa onboard that crashed on [[Burantia|Planet WG4587]]. The [[Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Mission to Planet WG4587|located]] the vessel and with Jinn's aid it took off. A [[kaijura]] the grabbed the ship until Colton launched all the corvette's [[escape pod]]s into it on Jinn's orders, forcing the creature to let go and allowing the corvette to escape. In [[19 BBY]], Colton piloted the ''Tantive III'' on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] during the final [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. Organa used the ship to aid his Jedi friends [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] and Kenobi, now a [[Jedi Master|Master]], after the [[Galactic Republic]] turned on the Jedi during [[Order 66]]. While the trio were on board, Colton informed Organa that [[Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda]] had sent him a message. He later brought Yoda and Organa to the [[Polis Massa]] [[asteroid field]], where Yoda departed for the [[Sluis sector]]. Colton continued to serve Bail Organa and then his daughter, [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], as a pilot, and was piloting the ''Tantive IV'' when it was [[Secret mission to Tatooine|captured]] above the planet [[Tatooine]] in [[1 BBY]]. Colton was arrested as a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and sent to [[Accresker Jail]], a mobile Imperial [[prison]], where he remained a prisoner of the [[Galactic Empire]]. At some point before the jail's [[Skirmish aboard Accresker Jail|destruction]] around [[1 ABY]], Colton was visited by [[Sava]] [[The Archivist|Madelin Sun]], who used a [[Thought Dowser]] to force him to reveal that Yoda had traveled to the Sluis [[sector]]. ==Biography== ===Kaijura crash=== {{Quote|Excuse me, senator… but we have a ''new problem''.|Colton warns Organa of an approaching pack of kaijura|[[Jedi Knights 3|''Jedi Knights'' 3]]}} Jeremoch Colton was a [[human]] with a long record of service to the [[House of Organa]], the royal family of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]].''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' He served as [[pilot]] of the [[Alderaanian]] [[CR70 corvette]] ''[[Tantive III]]'' and the [[CR90 corvette]][[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles (second edition)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles'', second edition]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'', [[Starship|vessels]] belonging to the family. Both [[corvette]]s were [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by Captain [[Raymus Antilles]] and were used by [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], [[Viceroy]] of Alderaan and [[Senator]] for the world in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the Republic.{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Bail Organa - Galactic Senate}} [[File:JeremochColton-JediKnights3.png|thumb|300px|right|alt=A brown-haired Jeremoch Colton rushes toward Bail Organa, Qui-Gon Jinn, and Obi-Wan Kenobi in the white corridor of a CR70 Corvette.|Colton (left) captained a corvette that crashed on Planet WG4587.]] Between [[40 BBY]] and [[34 BBY]],The events of [[Jedi Knights 3|''Jedi Knights'' 3]] take place between [[40 BBY]] and [[34 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:JediKnightsDate|here]]. Colton{{DMCite|dm=File:JeremochColton-MarcGuggenheimTwitter.png|creator=Marc Guggenheim|date=2025-05-14}} was captain of a CR70 corvette transporting Organa when it crashed on the uncharted [[Burantia|Planet WG4587]], home of huge creatures known as [[kaijura]]. The crash damaged the vessels [[repulsorlift]] and destroyed the weapons systems but left the [[engine]] and a [[transponder beacon]] functioning. The [[Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were [[Mission to Planet WG4587|dispatched]] to find Organa and his crew and used the beacon to locate them; however, upon arriving on Planet WG4587, the pair's [[T-6 shuttle]] was destroyed by a kaijura. The Jedi still managed to make it to the crashed corvette, where Organa explained the extent of the damage to them Colton then approached and warned the trio that a pack of at least nine kaijuras were rapidly approaching. Jinn then ordered Colton to restart the repulsorlifts with as much power as possible, although they could only reach half power, and then used [[the Force]] to provide the rest of the lift the ship needed to take off. A kaijura then stood and grabbed the rear of the ship, halting its progress, so Jinn ordered Colton to fire all weapons at the beast. When he learned the weapons were destroyed, he instead had the captain launch all the ship's [[escape pod]]s in to the creature, causing it to release the ship and allowing them to escape safely and return home. Kenobi later wrote an after-action report on the incident, including Colton's actions. ===Pilot of the ''Tantive III''=== {{Quote|So you can read a prisoner transcript. Good for you.''"
"''I read a ''lot'' of datafiles. That's how I know you ''also'' flew a ship called the ''Tantive III'' when it helped Jedi Master Yoda escape Palpatine's purge. I need to know where you took him.|Jeremoch Colton and Madelin Sun|}} By [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to [[19 BBY]]. during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Colton held the rank of [[captain]].{{BuildR2Cite|99|Building the Galaxy}} That [[Standard year|year]], the ''Tantive III'' was on the Republic's [[capital]] world of [[Coruscant]] during the events of [[Order 66]], in which the [[Grand Army of the Republic|forces]] of the Republic turned on their allies in the [[Jedi Order]]. Keen to help some of the surviving Jedi escape death, Organa had the ''Tantive III'' leave Coruscant in order to rescue [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] and Kenobi, now a [[Jedi Master]]. [[File:ColtonCockpit.png|thumb|left|300px|Captain Colton piloted the ''Tantive III''.]] Upon returning to Coruscant, Organa and the two Jedi were in the vessel's [[cockpit]] with Colton and his co-pilot when a message from the [[Emperor's office|office]] of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] reached the ship. Colton informed Organa of the message and, on the viceroy's orders, patched through [[Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda]], who informed Organa of a [[Proclamation of the New Order|special session]] being held in the Senate. Once the message ended, Organa and the Jedi discussed the possibility of the session being a trap but decided that it was likely authentic. As such, it presented a good opportunity for the Jedi to infiltrate the fallen [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] and alter a [[Jedi beacon|beacon]] being used to lure Jedi to their [[death]]s. Colton then piloted the ''Tantive III'' to the [[Imperial Senate Building|Galactic Senate Building]] so that Organa could attend the session. Following the session and the Jedi's successful mission, the ''Tantive III'' left Coruscant again and carried Organa and Yoda to the [[Polis Massa]] [[asteroid field]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]].''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' From there, Yoda departed in his own craft, although Colton learned that he was traveling to a [[Dagobah|location]] in the [[Sluis sector]]. ===Pilot of the ''Tantive IV''=== {{Quote|Get us into hyperspace.|Antilles ordering the ''Tantive IV'' to jump from Scarif|[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]}} [[File:TantiveIV-Pilots-RO.png|thumb|right|300px|Jeremoch Colton piloted the ''Tantive IV'' for the Rebel Alliance.]] After they departed Polis Massa, Colton continued to fly as Organa's pilot while the senator served in the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[time]], Colton began to instead serve Organa's adopted daughter, [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who not only served alongside her father in the senate, but also in secretly opposing the Empire as part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Organa used the ''Tantive IV'' as her consular ship, with Colton still piloting it under the command of Antilles. In [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]]. after sustaining damage on a mission, the ''Tantive IV'' was undergoing repairs{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View}} at the Alliance's [[Great Temple|headquarters]]''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] when it was assigned a routine [[Secret mission to Tatooine|mission]] to the planet [[Tatooine]], where Bail wanted Leia to make contact with Kenobi.{{Film|IV}} However, before the repairs were completed, the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] was scrambled for an [[Battle of Scarif|attack]] on [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] on the planet [[Scarif]] to try and obtain the [[Death Star plans|plans]] for the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. Unable to make the journey on its own, the ''Tantive IV'' was transported to Scarif on board the [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Profundity]]'' as repairs continued. At Scarif, the Death Star plans were successfully transmitted to the ''Profundity''; however, the [[cruiser]] was crippled by the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' and left unable to escape. In order to prevent the plans from falling back into Imperial hands, they were brought onto the ''Tantive IV'', which launched from the hangar of the ''Profundity'' with Colton at the helm as Imperial forces captured the cruiser. Antilles gave the order to jump to [[hyperspace]] before handing the plans over to Organa. ===Final pursuit=== {{Quote|You were a pilot for the Organa family. First for Bail, and then his daughter, ''Leia''. The Imperials captured the ''Tantive IV'' while you were piloting it. ''Darth Vader'' killed its captain, ''Raymus Antilles'', and you ended up here, accused of working with the ''Rebel Alliance''.|Madelin Sun summarizes Colton's career|}} The ''Tantive IV'' was then pursued by the ''Devastator'' as it left the [[Scarif system]] and, on Antilles's orders, Colton piloted the vessel''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' on a direct''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' route to Tatooine that followed no clear line and doubled back on itself in order to try and evade the [[Star Destroyer]]. The corvette traveled to [[Ukio]], [[Roon]], [[Kowak]], and then [[Hypori]], but found the ''Devastator'' waiting for it there. After being struck by a volly of the [[Destroyer]]'s [[turbolaser]]s, Colton jumped the ''Tantive IV'' to the worlds of [[Iskalon]] and then [[Vuzsa]] before reaching the [[Tatoo system]]. [[File:TantiveIVcapture-hd.png|thumb|left|300px|Captain Colton was piloting the ''Tantive IV'' when it was captured by the Empire, resulting in his imprisonment in Accresker Jail.]] Before it could reach Tatooine, the ''Tantive IV's'' [[motivator]] gave out, causing the ship to drop out of hyperspace. Antilles rushed to the bridge to find out what had happened, and Colton updated him on the situation, explaining that they would need to travel by [[sublight engine]] for the remaining quarter [[parsec]] of the journey, which would take about eight [[Standard minute|minutes]]. Alarms then sounded and Colton informed Antilles that the ''Devastator'' had arrived in the [[star system]]. After the Star Destroyer's turbolasers breached the [[Deflector shield|shields]] of the ''Tantive IV'' and damaged the main [[reactor]], Antilles gave the order for the reactor to be turned off in order to save the ship from destruction, but leaving it dead in [[Realspace|space]]. The Star Destroyer then captured the ''Tantive IV'' with a [[tractor beam]], and it was boarded by Imperials led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], who killed Antilles and captured Leia Organa and the other surviving members of the crew including Colton. The plans however were no longer on board, as Organa had given them to the [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]], who would ultimately deliver them to the Alliance, allowing it to [[Battle of Yavin|destroy]] the [[Death Star]]. ===Imprisonment and torture=== {{Quote|I don't like this place. Prisons are terrible.''"
"''Imagine how bad they are if you can't leave. Are you going to tell me who you are? I've been here for for over three years and haven't had one visitor.|Madelin Sun and Jeremoch Colton|}} [[File:ColtonPrisoner-CrimsonReign3.png|thumb|right|300px|Madelin Sun visited Jeremoch Colton while he was imprisoned in Accresker Jail.]] Despite Leia Organa's claims that they were on a diplomatic mission rather than one for the Alliance, Colton was accused of working for the rebels and sent to the [[Accresker Jail]]. He received no visitors in the mobile prison until [[Sava]] [[The Archivist|Madelin Sun]] tracked him down while trying to locate Yoda for the [[Crimson Dawn]] criminal syndicate sometime before around [[1 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Doctor Aphra (2016) 25|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 25]], which depicts the [[Skirmish aboard Accresker Jail|destruction]] of [[Accresker Jail]], to around [[1 ABY]]. although Colton claimed to have not had visitors for over three years. Sun questioned Colton on where the Jedi had gone after flying on the ''Tantive III'', but the pilot feigned ignorance. Sun then used a [[Thought Dowser]] on Colton, which caused him increasing pain as he resisted telling her what he knew. Eventually he admitted that Yoda had left in his own vessel from Polis Massa and traveled to the Sluis sector, but said he had never learned the Jedi's final coordinates. Satisfied, Sun stopped using the device on him and left the prison while Colton remained in his cell. Accresker Jail was [[Skirmish aboard Accresker Jail|decommissioned]][[Doctor Aphra (2016) 22|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 22]] and then destroyed not long after the visit around 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Nnnngh!''"
"''Your mind belongs to me now. The more you resist the more it hurts, and in the end, it will make no difference. Tell me where you took Yoda, and this stops.''"
"''Don't…know…|Colton and Madelin Sun|}} [[File:ColtonTortured-CrimsonReign3.png|thumb|left|300px|Jeremoch Colton was tortured with a Thought Dowser by Madelin Sun.]] Colton was a light-skinned human [[Gender|male]] with [[Color|brown]] [[hair]] that later turned gray and blue [[eye]]s. He acted as somewhat of a [[Teacher|mentor]] figure to Captain Antilles. When reporting to Antilles that they were eight minutes away from Tatooine, Colton had hope in his voice and a sense of relief, although it was quickly dashed by the arrival of the ''Devastator''. When Sun visited Colton he was sarcastic and pretended to know nothing about Yoda's location until [[torture]]d. He initially resisted the effects of the Thought Dowser but ultimately succumbed and revealed what he knew. ==Skills and abilities== Colton was an extraordinary pilot with above-average intelligence. He had average strength, speed, diplomatic skill, and fighting ability. He was not [[Force-sensitive]]. ==Equipment== While in service aboard the ''Tantive III'', Colton wore a gray [[Clothing|uniform]] and a silver-colored headset. On the ''Tantive IV'', he wore a brown jacket with a black vest and a white [[helmet]]. While imprisoned in Accreseeker Jail, Colton wore an orange [[jumpsuit]] with a black collar and shoulders along with a pair of black [[boot]]s and silver-colored handcuffs. ==Behind the scenes== ===More than a mysterious conundrum=== {{Quote|Wouldn't it be nice to have Boba Fett sitting just like this and pulling his helmet off… and there's Captain Colton. That would be cool.|Jeremy Bulloch|{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/original-trilogy/episode-v-the-empire-strikes-back/jeremy-bulloch-boba-fett|text=Jeremy Bulloch|author=Pellegrom, Dennis|archivedate=20201221161541|nolive=1}}}} [[File:JeremyBullochBobaFett.png|thumb|right|250px|Colton was portrayed by Boba Fett actor Jeremy Bulloch.]] Jeremoch Colton was portrayed by actor [[Jeremy Bulloch]] in a cameo appearance in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the third installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]]. The character's name is not spoken in the film, but his surname is given in the credits along with his rank. "Jeremoch," a [[Tuckerization|portmanteau]] of Bulloch's name, was first mentioned as Colton's first name in the new ''Star Wars'' [[canon]] in "[[Revenge of the Sith: In Their Own Words|''Revenge of the Sith'': In Their Own Words]]," an article written by [[Mark Newbold]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 157|issue 157]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine{{InsiderCite|157|Revenge of the Sith: In Their Own Words|''Revenge of the Sith'': In Their Own Words}} on [[April 21]], [[2015]].{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/157|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #157 @ Titan Magazines}} Bulloch had previously portrayed [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]{{Film|V}} and the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].{{Film|VI}} Colton's scene in the film was added during pickups filmed on F Stage at [[Shepperton Studios]] on Tuesday, [[August 31]], [[2004]], although director [[George Lucas]] had decided to have Bulloch cameo in the film long before that. Wishing for Bulloch to be more than just a "mysterious conundrum," Lucas claimed that he and others had been looking for somewhere to put the actor and decided Colton's role was the best place for him.''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]'' Bulloch received the offer for the role from producer [[Rick McCallum]] while on holiday in [[Wikipedia:Tuscany|Tuscany]] in 2004, at first thinking the phone call was a joke as few people had his telephone number. He was astonished when offered the small role, and found it odd returning to ''Star Wars'' as a different character,{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2021|Jeremy Bulloch: Inside Boba Fett}} although he was pleased to discover that Colton's name was a portmanteau of his own. In one interview, he joked that it would fun if Boba Fett was revealed to actually be Colton underneath his mask. ===Origins and retcon=== [[File:FromtheAdventuresofLukeSkywalker.png|thumb|left|250px|Colton was first mentioned in Alan Dean Foster's novelization of ''A New Hope''.]] In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, a Captain Colton was first mentioned in the [[1976]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]] which was written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' In the novel, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] claims that he and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] last master was a Captain Colton. The [[1984]] reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' by [[Raymond L. Velasco]] clarified that the Colton mentioned in the novelization was simply a misnaming of [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]],''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'' although the [[1995]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' by [[Andy Mangels]] then mentioned Colton and Antilles as separate characters.''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' [[StarWars.com]] Internet Content Developer{{StarWarsShow|GvT2F1j-SvA|Pablo Hidalgo Extended Interview|sw_url=video/pablo-hidalgo-extended-interview}} [[Pablo Hidalgo]] then suggested that Bulloch's character in ''Revenge of the Sith'' be named Colton based on the ''A New Hope'' novelization.{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1538628163315519489|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Since Captain Antilles was already in the movie and played by another actor (Rohan Nichol), I suggested naming Bulloch's character Captain Colton as a nod to this very obscure name dropped in the original '76 novelization.|archivedate=20220619212354 }} Hidalgo then established Jeremoch as the definitively separate character's first name in "[[Refresher Reading]]," an article published in the ''Star Wars Insider'' magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 90|ninetieth issue]]{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}} on [[September 25]], [[2006]].{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20060925.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars Insider'' #90}} Colton appeared in a flashback in the [[Crimson Reign 3|third issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Reign]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[Charles Soule]], illustrated by [[Steven Cummings]], and released on [[March 9]], [[2022]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamesradar.com/marvel-comics-march-2022-solicitations|text=Marvel Comics March 2022 comics revealed|work=Newsarama|archivedate=20211222154519}} The comic revealed that Colton was the pilot of the ''Tantive IV'' at the time of its capture. This [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] the unnamed pilot of the ''Tantive IV'' that appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', and in the short story "[[Raymus]]," written by [[Gary Whitta]] and released in the [[2017]] anthology ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]'', into being Colton. The comic also showed that a ''Tantive IV'' crew member other than Organa survived the vessel's capture, which contradicts statements saying that all other crew members were killed made in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 18|eightheenth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine,{{BuildFalconCite|18|Starship Fact File}} Interior Layout released around [[May 6]], 2015,{{BMFdates|18}} and the [[2021]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Jeremoch Colton}} *[[Jedi Knights 3|''Jedi Knights'' 3]] {{Flash}} *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{Ret}} *{{StoryCite|story=Raymus|book=From a Certain Point of View|audiobook=1}} {{Ret}} *[[Crimson Reign 3|''Crimson Reign'' 3]] {{Flash}} ==Sources== *{{SWE|characters|captainantilles|Captain Antilles}} *{{InsiderCite|157|Revenge of the Sith: In Their Own Words|''Revenge of the Sith'': In Their Own Words|reprint=1}} {{1stID|Jeremoch}} *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *{{BuildR2Cite|17|Building the Galaxy}} *{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Reborn|cardname=ROTS-18 - Captain Colton|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/135181/cid/10118793/2017-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files:-Reborn-ROTS-18-Captain-Colton}} *{{BustCollectionCite|25|Behind the Cameras}} *{{BuildR2Cite|99|Building the Galaxy}} *{{InsiderCite|190|Jeremy Bulloch: Inside Boba Fett|reprint=1}} *{{SW|url=news/jeremy-bulloch|text=Boba Fett Performer Jeremy Bulloch Passes Away}} *{{InsiderCite|201|Launchpad}} *[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] *''[[Under the Helmet: The Legacy of Boba Fett]]'' *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-fun-facts-trivia|text=Wookiee Basketball, Kid Han Solo, and a Kenobi Dummy: 20 Fun Facts about ''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith''}} ==Notes and references== {{ScrollBox|content={{Reflist}}}} {{Interlang |es=Jeremoch Colton |ja=ジェレモック・コルトン |ka=ჯერემოქ კოლტონი |pl=Jeremoch Colton |tr=Jeremoch Colton }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Colton, Jeremoch}} [[Category:Alliance Fleet personnel]] [[Category:Captains]] [[Category:Galactic Republic individuals]] [[Category:House of Organa]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Pilots]]
